name: steghide

technical_body.install_hint: brew install steghide  # or: apt install steghide
technical_body.algorithm: graph-matching-based JPEG scheme with AES-256 payload encryption
technical_body.format_compat: steghide-only; not interoperable with F5, jsteg, OutGuess, or ST3GG
technical_body.interop_notes: Reads only its own container format. See myth-steghide-reads-outguess for the common CTF trap.

notes: Historical reference tool for JPEG steg. Distinctive header + AES-256 password gate. Present via `bin:steghide` capability check.

name: jsteg (reference implementation)

technical_body.install_hint: cargo install jsteg  # or build from Derek Upham's original C source
technical_body.algorithm: LSB replacement on nonzero AC DCT coefficients, 16-bit length prefix
technical_body.interop_notes: ST3GG's img_core.jsteg_encode is round-trip-compatible with the reference implementation on the wire format.

notes: The technique the chi-square attack was invented against. Almost never used for real hides today; a puzzle-genre staple.

name: OutGuess

technical_body.install_hint: brew install outguess  # or: apt install outguess
technical_body.algorithm: statistical-preserving JPEG: reserve half the coefficients as correction and embed in the other half so the DCT histogram is preserved
technical_body.interop_notes: Not readable by steghide, F5, or jsteg. Historical significance: first JPEG scheme that survived chi-square.

notes: Preserves DCT histograms; defeats naive chi-square. Present via `bin:outguess` capability check.

name: zsteg

technical_body.algorithm: brute-force channel × bit-plane × direction × alignment combinations, looking for printable ASCII / high-entropy runs
technical_body.interop_notes: CTF staple for PNG/BMP LSB. Reads ST3GG-encoded PNGs at the bit level but doesn't understand the ST3GG v3 header, so the raw bit dump may or may not be human-readable depending on encryption.

notes: First tool to reach for on unknown PNG/BMP LSB. Runs fast, produces false positives on smooth carriers.

name: StegDetect

capabilities: JPEG signature scan for jsteg, jphide, invisible-secrets, outguess, F5, appendX, camouflage
technical_body.algorithm: statistical + signature detectors, one per targeted tool
technical_body.interop_notes: Long unmaintained. False-fires on modern JPEGs; results should corroborate structural evidence, not stand alone.

notes: The classic JPEG steg-detection tool. Historical significance; keep in the toolkit for the F5 signature scan even though the tool is aging.

name: binwalk

technical_body.install_hint: brew install binwalk  # or: apt install binwalk
capabilities: magic-byte scanning across arbitrary binary files
technical_body.algorithm: magic-byte scan with signature library; --extract carves recognized formats
technical_body.interop_notes: Overlaps with ST3GG's stegg_carve (which is more targeted at known steg carriers).

notes: First tool to run on an unknown binary suspected of embedded content. Fires on trailing data past IEND/EOI, on ZIP-in-PNG polyglots, on any recognized magic sequence.

name: foremost

technical_body.install_hint: brew install foremost  # or: apt install foremost
capabilities: file-carving from unstructured byte streams (disk images, memory dumps, arbitrary blobs)
technical_body.interop_notes: Complementary to binwalk. binwalk is scan-first; foremost is carve-first. For steg CTF work, binwalk usually suffices.

notes: Forensics-lineage tool; born in the DFRWS carving-challenge era. Handles disk-image scale better than binwalk.

name: StegExpose

capabilities: batch RS / SPA / primary-set-fusion / chi-square analysis over LSB steg in PNG/BMP
technical_body.algorithm: ensemble of statistical LSB detectors with configurable threshold
technical_body.interop_notes: Batch-oriented; useful when triaging a directory. ST3GG's stegg_triage exposes the same probes on single files.

notes: Free Java batch scanner. Common in academic reproducibility work (paired with StegoAppDB and Alaska2).

name: Aletheia

technical_body.install_hint: pip install aletheia-py  # + trained detector weights
capabilities: ML-based detection of JUNIWARD, UED, nsF5, HUGO, S-UNIWARD in JPEGs; F5 / jsteg / OutGuess classical detection
technical_body.algorithm: ensemble: SRM / DCTR / GFR feature families + a Random Forest / SRNet classifier
technical_body.interop_notes: State-of-the-art for adaptive JPEG steg detection as of ~2024. Reference tool from the Alaska2 competition era.

notes: Modern-era research-grade JPEG steg detector. Requires trained weights and is significantly heavier than zsteg/StegExpose.

name: ExifTool

technical_body.install_hint: brew install exiftool  # or: apt install libimage-exiftool-perl
capabilities: read / write EXIF / XMP / IPTC / ICC across ~140 file formats
technical_body.algorithm: format-specific parsers with 25k+ known tag definitions
technical_body.interop_notes: First tool to run for metadata-channel steg. ST3GG's stegg_read_metadata uses Pillow + optional exiftool; the exiftool binary reads more tags.

notes: Not a steg tool per se, but every metadata-channel hide is exposed by exiftool. Present via `bin:exiftool` capability check.
